title: Allergen and Food Safety Information
text:
The product label on the package you receive is the authoritative source of ingredient and allergen
information. Suppliers can change recipes; we update product pages within 2 business days of being
notified, but the label always wins. If you have a severe allergy, read the label of every product
before use, every time, and speak with your doctor or allergist about what is safe for you. Our
customer service and our chat assistant can tell you what our policies say, but they cannot give
medical advice or confirm that a product is safe for a specific person.

title: Allergen and Food Safety Information
text:
Health Canada identifies priority food allergens that must be declared on labels: eggs, milk,
mustard, peanuts, crustaceans and molluscs, fish, sesame seeds, soy, sulphites, tree nuts, and wheat
and triticale. Gluten sources must also be declared. Every food product we sell carries a bilingual
(French and English) label that lists these allergens in the ingredient list or in a "Contains"
statement.

title: Allergen and Food Safety Information
text:
Some products carry a "may contain" statement, for example "may contain peanuts" or "peut contenir
des arachides". This means the product was made in a facility or on equipment that also handles the
allergen and that cross-contamination cannot be ruled out. We do not remove products with
precautionary statements from the search results, but the allergen filter on the website can hide
them.

title: Allergen and Food Safety Information
text:
On every category page and in search results, the "Allergens" filter lets you exclude products that
contain, or may contain, one or more priority allergens. The filter uses the information supplied by
the manufacturer. It is a convenience, not a guarantee: always confirm with the label.

title: Allergen and Food Safety Information
section: Shared facilities and our specialty range
text:
Our specialty chocolates, baked goods and confectionery come from small Québec and Maritime
producers. Many of these producers work in shared kitchens that also handle tree nuts, peanuts,
wheat, milk and eggs. Unless a product page explicitly says "made in a dedicated allergen-free
facility", assume that cross-contamination is possible. We cannot guarantee that any product is
completely free of an allergen.

title: Allergen and Food Safety Information
text:
A product described as "gluten-free" meets the Canadian standard: it contains no gluten above
20 parts per million and no intentionally added gluten sources. Oats are labelled gluten-free only
when they come from a specialised supply chain.

title: Allergen and Food Safety Information
text:
Some non-food items can also matter to people with allergies or sensitivities. Scented candles and
diffusers contain fragrance compounds; some balloons and party items contain natural rubber latex;
some wooden kitchen tools are finished with food-safe oils that can include nut oils. These products
list their materials on the product page.

title: Allergen and Food Safety Information
text:
We follow the recall notices of the Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA). When a product we sold is
recalled, we remove it from sale immediately and e-mail every customer who bought it in the
affected period within 24 hours, with instructions. You receive a full refund for a recalled
product, whether or not you still have it, and you should not return it unless the notice asks you
to. Recall notices are also posted on the home page.

title: Allergen and Food Safety Information
text:
If you think you are having an allergic reaction, call 911 or your local emergency number
immediately. After the situation is under control, please contact us with the product name, the
lot number on the package and your order number so that we can investigate with the supplier and,
if needed, report to the CFIA.

title: Allergen and Food Safety Information
section: Storage and food safety at home
text:
Refrigerate perishable products as soon as they are delivered and respect the storage instructions
on the label. Do not eat chilled products that arrived above 4 °C or whose packaging is damaged:
report them under our quality guarantee (see the Returns policy) and we will refund them.

title: Delivery and Shipping Policy
text:
Boréal Marché delivers groceries and specialty goods to addresses in Québec, Ontario and the
Maritime provinces (New Brunswick, Nova Scotia and Prince Edward Island). Newfoundland and Labrador
is served for non-perishable products only. We do not deliver perishable or refrigerated products
outside Canada. Customers outside Canada can order non-perishable specialty goods (decor, kitchen
and gift items) through our international service described below. We cannot deliver to post office
boxes for orders that contain perishable products, because those orders need a person or a safe
place at the door within a fixed window.

title: Delivery and Shipping Policy
text:
Delivery times are counted in business days (Monday to Friday, excluding statutory holidays) from
the moment your order is confirmed, which is when payment is authorised.

| Region | Perishable orders | Non-perishable orders |
|---|---|---|
| Greater Montréal and Québec City | Next day if ordered before 2:00 p.m. (Eastern) | 1 to 2 business days |
| Rest of Québec | 2 to 3 business days | 2 to 4 business days |
| Ottawa, Toronto and the Golden Horseshoe | 2 business days | 2 to 3 business days |
| Rest of Ontario | 3 business days | 3 to 5 business days |
| New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island | 3 to 4 business days | 4 to 6 business days |
| Newfoundland and Labrador | not available | 5 to 8 business days |
| International (non-perishable only) | not available | 7 to 15 business days |

title: Delivery and Shipping Policy
text:
These are targets, not guarantees. Severe weather, road closures and carrier disruptions can add one
or more days; when that happens we notify you by e-mail and text message as soon as we know.

title: Delivery and Shipping Policy
text:
In Greater Montréal and Québec City our own refrigerated vans deliver in three-hour windows, Monday
to Saturday: 8:00–11:00, 11:00–14:00, 14:00–17:00 and 17:00–20:00. You choose the window at
checkout; the earliest available window depends on the order time and on van capacity. You can
change the window up to 10:00 p.m. on the day before delivery from the "My orders" page. Outside
these two areas, orders are shipped by a partner carrier, which delivers during the day without a
choice of window. The tracking link in your confirmation e-mail shows the carrier's estimate.

title: Delivery and Shipping Policy
text:
Perishable products (dairy, fresh bakery, chilled specialty items) travel in insulated boxes with
gel ice packs designed to keep them at or below 4 °C for 48 hours. To make sure a perishable parcel
never sits in a depot over a weekend, perishable orders to the Maritimes and to the rest of Ontario
ship only from Monday to Wednesday. Orders placed on Thursday, Friday or the weekend ship the
following Monday. Please refrigerate perishable products as soon as you receive them. The insulated
boxes are recyclable and the gel packs are non-toxic; you can return boxes to our van drivers in
Montréal and Québec City for reuse.

title: Delivery and Shipping Policy
text:
| Region | Standard fee | Free delivery from |
|---|---|---|
| Québec | $6.95 | $75 before taxes |
| Ontario | $8.95 | $75 before taxes |
| Maritimes | $12.95 | $100 before taxes |
| Newfoundland and Labrador | $16.95 | $150 before taxes |
| International | calculated at checkout | not available |

Members of the Boréal Rewards loyalty programme at the Boréal tier get free delivery from $50, and
members at the Aurore tier get free delivery on every order (see the Loyalty Programme Terms). The
free-delivery threshold is calculated on the value of the products after discounts and before
taxes; gift cards do not count toward it.

title: Delivery and Shipping Policy
text:
If nobody is home during a van delivery, the driver leaves non-perishable products at the door or
in the safe place you indicated at checkout, and takes a photo. Perishable products are never left
unattended: they are brought back to our Laval depot and kept refrigerated. You can book a new
window for the next day for a $5 redelivery fee, or pick the order up at the Laval depot free of
charge within 48 hours. After 48 hours perishable products are donated to a partner food bank and
refunded as store credit, minus the delivery fee. For carrier deliveries, the carrier leaves a
notice and holds the parcel at the nearest pickup point for five business days.

title: Delivery and Shipping Policy
text:
Every order receives a confirmation e-mail with an order number that starts with "BM". When the
order leaves our warehouse you receive a tracking link by e-mail and, if you gave us a mobile
number, by text message. For van deliveries in Montréal and Québec City the link shows the van's
position on the day of delivery and a 30-minute arrival estimate.

title: Delivery and Shipping Policy
text:
We do not deliver on statutory holidays: New Year's Day, Good Friday, Victoria Day / National
Patriots' Day, the Fête nationale du Québec (June 24) in Québec, Canada Day (July 1), Labour Day,
Thanksgiving, Christmas Day and Boxing Day. Orders that would arrive on a holiday arrive on the next
business day. For the end-of-year season, the last day to order for delivery before December 24 is
published on the home page at the beginning of November; it is usually December 18 for the
Maritimes and December 21 for Greater Montréal and Québec City.

title: Delivery and Shipping Policy
text:
International orders contain non-perishable specialty goods only. They are shipped by a tracked
international courier. Import duties, taxes and customs fees of the destination country are paid by
the customer on delivery and are not refunded if a parcel is refused. Delivery times are estimates
because customs clearance is outside our control.

title: Delivery and Shipping Policy
text:
Business accounts that order in wholesale quantities (see the Ordering and Payment Policy) receive
pallet or multi-box shipments by freight carrier. Freight deliveries require a loading area or a
person able to receive the boxes, and are booked by our business desk with a two-hour window.

title: Delivery and Shipping Policy
text:
Customer service answers delivery questions Monday to Friday 8:00–20:00 and Saturday 9:00–17:00
(Eastern time) by chat on the website, by e-mail at support@borealmarche.example and by telephone
at 1-800-555-0142. Please have your order number ready.

title: Boréal Rewards Loyalty Programme Terms
text:
Boréal Rewards is free. Any person aged 18 or over with a Canadian delivery address can join from
the "My account" page; customers outside Canada can join but cannot redeem points on international
orders. One membership per person; memberships cannot be shared or transferred. Business accounts
have a separate programme described in their business agreement.

title: Boréal Rewards Loyalty Programme Terms
text:
Members earn 1 point for every dollar spent on products, after discounts and before taxes. Points
are not earned on taxes, delivery fees, gift card purchases or the part of an order paid with
points. Points appear in your account when the order is delivered. Members receive a 200-point
bonus in the month of their birthday, and from time to time we run promotions that award extra
points on selected products; the conditions of each promotion are shown on the product page.

title: Boréal Rewards Loyalty Programme Terms
text:
Every 500 points can be redeemed for $5 off an order. The minimum redemption is 500 points and
points can pay for up to 50% of the value of the products in an order. You choose how many points
to use at checkout. Points cannot be exchanged for cash or gift cards.

title: Boréal Rewards Loyalty Programme Terms
text:
Your tier depends on the points you earned in the last 12 months and is recalculated on the first
day of every month.

| Tier | Points earned in the last 12 months | Benefits |
|---|---|---|
| Essentiel | 0 to 499 | Earn and redeem points; birthday bonus |
| Boréal | 500 to 1,499 | Free delivery from $50; early access to seasonal collections |
| Aurore | 1,500 or more | Free delivery on every order; free change-of-mind return labels; priority customer service |

title: Boréal Rewards Loyalty Programme Terms
text:
Points do not expire as long as your account is active. An account is inactive when no order has
been delivered for 12 consecutive months; the points on an inactive account expire at the end of
that 12-month period. We send a reminder by e-mail 30 days before points expire.

title: Boréal Rewards Loyalty Programme Terms
text:
Points earned on products you return or on orders you cancel are removed from your balance. If you
redeemed points on an order and then return part of it, the points are returned to your account in
proportion to the value of the products you returned.

title: Boréal Rewards Loyalty Programme Terms
section: Quarterly offers and how members are selected
text:
Each quarter, some members receive a personal discount offer (currently 15% off one order). To
decide who receives it, Boréal Marché uses an automated estimate of how likely each customer is to
order again in the next 90 days, based on the dates and amounts of past orders. A member of the marketing
team reviews and approves every offer list before it is sent. The estimate is not used to change
prices, to refuse service or to change your tier. You can ask which information and main factors
were used for your account, have inaccurate information corrected, ask a staff member to review the
decision, or opt out of this profiling while staying a member: see the Privacy Notice.

title: Boréal Rewards Loyalty Programme Terms
text:
We may change these terms with 30 days' notice by e-mail and on the website. If we end the
programme, members will have at least 90 days to redeem their points.

title: Boréal Rewards Loyalty Programme Terms
text:
For questions about your points balance or tier, see "My account → Boréal Rewards" or contact
customer service at support@borealmarche.example or 1-800-555-0142.

title: Ordering, Payment and Account Policy
text:
You can order on the website or in the mobile app, with or without an account; a guest order
cannot earn Boréal Rewards points and its history is not kept in an account. Prices are in Canadian
dollars. The minimum order is $35 before taxes for orders that contain perishable products; there is
no minimum for orders of non-perishable products only. When the order is placed you receive a
confirmation e-mail with an order number starting with "BM".

title: Ordering, Payment and Account Policy
text:
We accept Visa, Mastercard and American Express credit cards, Visa and Mastercard debit cards,
PayPal, Boréal Marché gift cards and Boréal Rewards points. Your card is authorised when you place
the order and charged when the order leaves our warehouse; if a product is unavailable, you are
charged only for what is shipped. We do not accept cash on delivery or cheques, except for approved
business accounts.

title: Ordering, Payment and Account Policy
text:
Federal GST and Québec QST, or HST in Ontario and the Atlantic provinces, are added at checkout
according to the delivery address. Basic groceries are zero-rated; specialty goods such as
decorations, kitchenware and confectionery are taxable. The tax amount appears on the invoice that
comes with the confirmation e-mail.

title: Ordering, Payment and Account Policy
text:
You can change the products, quantities, delivery window or address of an order, or cancel it, from
"My orders" until 10:00 p.m. on the day before delivery for van deliveries, or until the order
status becomes "In preparation" for carrier deliveries. After that, the order can no longer be
changed; you can refuse a carrier parcel or return non-perishable products under the Returns
policy. A cancelled order is refunded in full to the original payment method; any points used are
returned to your account.

title: Ordering, Payment and Account Policy
text:
When a product in your order is out of stock on the day of preparation, we can replace it with a
similar product of the same or lower price, if you allowed substitutions for that product at
checkout. Substituted products are clearly marked on the delivery slip; you can refuse a
substitution at the door or return it free of charge within 7 days. If you did not allow
substitutions, the missing product is removed and not charged.

title: Ordering, Payment and Account Policy
text:
Prices shown at the time you place the order are the prices you pay, even if they change before
delivery. In case of an obvious pricing error, we contact you before preparing the order and you may
cancel it. Promotional codes are applied at checkout, one code per order, and cannot be combined
with the quarterly loyalty offer unless the code says so. We do not price-match other retailers.

title: Ordering, Payment and Account Policy
text:
Gift cards are sold in amounts from $25 to $500. In accordance with Québec law they do not expire
and have no inactivity fees. Gift cards can be used for products and delivery fees but not to buy
other gift cards. A lost gift card can be replaced if you have the purchase receipt.

title: Ordering, Payment and Account Policy
text:
Businesses (cafés, gift shops, offices) can apply for a business account. Business accounts get
wholesale pricing on orders of 24 units or more of the same product, freight delivery, and, after
approval, payment by invoice at 30 days. Business accounts are managed by our business desk at
business@borealmarche.example.

title: Ordering, Payment and Account Policy
text:
You can update your name, addresses, telephone number and communication preferences in "My
account". To close your account, use "My account → Privacy → Close my account" or write to
privacy@borealmarche.example; we confirm the closure within 30 days. Closing your account cancels
your Boréal Rewards membership and any unused points.

title: Ordering, Payment and Account Policy
text:
Customer service is open Monday to Friday 8:00–20:00 and Saturday 9:00–17:00 (Eastern time), in
French and English, by chat, by e-mail at support@borealmarche.example and by telephone at
1-800-555-0142. Outside these hours the chat assistant answers questions about our policies and your
orders and passes anything it cannot answer to the team for the next business day.

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
section: Who is responsible for your personal information
text:
Boréal Marché is responsible for the personal information it collects. Our person in charge of the
protection of personal information is the Chief Privacy Officer, who can be reached at
privacy@borealmarche.example or by mail at Boréal Marché, Privacy Office, Laval, Québec. Their title
and contact information are published on our website, as Québec's Act respecting the protection of
personal information in the private sector (Law 25) requires.

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
text:
We collect the information you give us when you create an account or order: your name, e-mail
address, telephone number, delivery and billing addresses, and your order history (dates, products,
quantities, amounts, cancellations and returns). Payment card numbers are processed by our payment
provider and are never stored by Boréal Marché. When you use the website we collect technical
information (device type, pages visited) through cookies that you can refuse, except for the cookies
strictly necessary to keep your basket and sign you in.

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
text:
We use your information to process and deliver your orders, provide customer service, run the Boréal
Rewards programme, prevent fraud, meet our legal obligations, and improve our services. With your
consent we also send you marketing e-mails, which you can stop at any time with the link in each
e-mail.

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
text:
We use an automated system to estimate how likely you are to order again in the next 90 days, based
on the dates and amounts of your past orders. This is a form of profiling. The estimate is used
only to decide who receives our quarterly discount offer; a member of our marketing team reviews and
approves every offer list, so the decision is not based exclusively on automated processing. You
can ask us which personal information and which main factors were used, ask us to correct
inaccurate information, submit your observations to a staff member who can review the decision, and
opt out of this profiling at any time. Our product recommendations ("you might also like") are based
on which products are bought together across all orders, not on a personal profile.

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
text:
The chat assistant answers questions from our published policies and can look up your own account
information when you are signed in. It will not disclose another customer's information. Questions
are processed on servers located in Canada. By default the assistant uses a model that runs on our
own infrastructure; we do not send your personal information to hosted language-model providers.
If the assistant cannot answer from our policies, it passes the conversation to a member of our team.

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
section: Where your information is stored and who sees it
text:
Your information is stored in Canada. Our delivery partners receive only what they need to deliver
your order (name, address, telephone number). Before any transfer outside Québec, we assess whether
the information would receive adequate protection, as Law 25 requires.

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
text:
We keep order records for 7 years for tax purposes. Account information is kept while your account
is active and deleted or anonymised 24 months after your last order or when you close your account,
unless the law requires us to keep it longer. Prediction logs used to monitor our models are kept
for 13 months and then deleted.

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
text:
You can ask to access your personal information, to have it corrected, to withdraw your consent, to
have it de-indexed, and to receive the computerised personal information you provided in a
structured, commonly used technological format. Write to privacy@borealmarche.example; we answer
within 30 days. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can file a complaint with the
Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec.

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
text:
If a confidentiality incident presents a risk of serious injury, we notify the Commission d'accès à
l'information and the people concerned without delay, and we keep a register of incidents.

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
section: Responsable de la protection des renseignements personnels
text:
Boréal Marché est responsable des renseignements personnels qu'elle recueille. La personne
responsable de la protection des renseignements personnels est notre chef de la protection de la
vie privée, joignable à privacy@borealmarche.example ou par la poste au Bureau de la vie privée,
Boréal Marché, Laval (Québec).

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
text:
Nous recueillons votre nom, votre adresse courriel, votre numéro de téléphone, vos adresses de
livraison et de facturation ainsi que l'historique de vos commandes (dates, produits, quantités,
montants, annulations et retours). Les numéros de carte de paiement sont traités par notre
fournisseur de paiement et ne sont jamais conservés par Boréal Marché. Nous utilisons ces
renseignements pour traiter et livrer vos commandes, offrir le service à la clientèle, gérer le
programme Boréal Récompenses, prévenir la fraude et respecter nos obligations légales.

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
text:
Nous utilisons un système automatisé pour estimer la probabilité que vous passiez une nouvelle
commande au cours des 90 prochains jours, à partir de l'historique de vos commandes et de votre
région de livraison. Il s'agit d'un profilage. Cette estimation sert uniquement à déterminer qui
reçoit notre offre de rabais trimestrielle; un membre de notre équipe marketing examine et approuve
chaque liste d'offres. Vous pouvez nous demander quels renseignements et quels principaux facteurs
ont été utilisés, faire corriger des renseignements inexacts, présenter vos observations à un membre
du personnel en mesure de réviser la décision, et refuser ce profilage en tout temps.

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
text:
L'assistant répond à partir de nos politiques publiées et peut consulter les renseignements de votre
propre compte lorsque vous êtes connecté. Il ne divulgue jamais les renseignements d'un autre client.
Par défaut, il utilise un modèle exécuté sur notre propre infrastructure au Canada; vos
renseignements personnels ne sont pas transmis à des fournisseurs de modèles de langage hébergés.

title: Privacy Notice / Avis de confidentialité
text:
Les dossiers de commande sont conservés 7 ans à des fins fiscales; les renseignements de compte sont
supprimés ou anonymisés 24 mois après votre dernière commande. Vous pouvez demander l'accès à vos
renseignements, leur rectification, le retrait de votre consentement, leur désindexation et leur
communication dans un format technologique structuré et couramment utilisé. Écrivez à
privacy@borealmarche.example; nous répondons dans un délai de 30 jours. Vous pouvez porter plainte
auprès de la Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec.

title: Returns, Refunds and Quality Guarantee
text:
We want every order to arrive complete, in good condition and as described. This policy explains
what you can return, how long you have, how refunds are paid and what we do when something arrives
damaged or wrong. It does not limit any right you have under the Québec Consumer Protection Act or
the consumer protection laws of your province.

title: Returns, Refunds and Quality Guarantee
text:
You can return non-perishable products (kitchenware, home decor, lighting, bags and wrapping,
stationery, toys and other specialty goods) within 30 days of delivery for a full refund of the
product price, provided the product is unused and in its original packaging with its labels. Items
that were opened but are faulty are covered by the damaged and defective items section below, not by
this section. Seasonal decorations bought between November 1 and December 24 can be returned until
January 15 of the following year.

title: Returns, Refunds and Quality Guarantee
section: Perishable products: quality guarantee instead of returns
text:
For food safety reasons we cannot take back perishable products (dairy, fresh bakery, chilled or
frozen specialty foods) or opened food products. Instead, our quality guarantee applies: if a
perishable product arrives spoiled, warm, past its best-before date or otherwise not up to standard,
report it within 48 hours of delivery with a photo of the product and its label. We refund the
product or credit your account, at your choice, without asking you to send the product back.

title: Returns, Refunds and Quality Guarantee
text:
If a product arrives damaged, does not work, or is not what you ordered, tell us within 7 days of
delivery. We send a replacement at no cost or refund you in full, including the share of the
delivery fee for that product. For large or fragile items we may ask for a photo before sending a
replacement. You do not pay return shipping for our mistakes: we e-mail you a prepaid label, or our
van driver collects the item at your next delivery in Montréal and Québec City.

title: Returns, Refunds and Quality Guarantee
text:
The following are final sale: gift cards; personalised or engraved items; products sold in the
"Dernière chance" clearance section; opened personal-care and hygiene items; and perishable products
(which are covered by the quality guarantee instead). Wholesale orders placed through a business
account follow the return terms of the business agreement.

title: Returns, Refunds and Quality Guarantee
text:
Sign in, open "My orders", select the order and choose "Return an item". Select the items and the
reason; you receive a return authorisation number and, where applicable, a prepaid label by e-mail.
You can also start a return through the chat assistant or by e-mail at
support@borealmarche.example with your order number (it starts with "BM"). Pack the items securely
with the return authorisation number and drop the parcel at any Canada Post outlet within 14 days of
receiving the authorisation. Returns sent without an authorisation number can take longer to
process.

title: Returns, Refunds and Quality Guarantee
text:
When you return a product because you changed your mind, a return label costs $7.95 and is deducted
from your refund. Returns are free when the product was damaged, defective or wrong, and for members
at the Aurore tier of the Boréal Rewards programme. International customers pay the return shipping
and any duties for change-of-mind returns.

title: Returns, Refunds and Quality Guarantee
text:
We inspect returned items within 3 business days of their arrival at our Laval warehouse. The refund
is then issued to the original payment method; your bank or card issuer usually takes 5 to 10
business days to show it. Refunds for orders paid with a gift card are credited back to a gift card.
If you prefer, you can receive store credit instead of a refund: store credit is issued immediately
after inspection and includes a 10% bonus on the refunded amount. Delivery fees are refunded only
when the whole order is returned because of our error.

title: Returns, Refunds and Quality Guarantee
text:
We do not process direct exchanges. Return the item for a refund and place a new order for the item
you want; if the new item is out of stock, our customer service can reserve it for 48 hours.

title: Returns, Refunds and Quality Guarantee
text:
Boréal Rewards points earned on a returned product are removed from your balance when the refund is
issued. If you used points to pay for part of the order, the points are returned to your account for
the share of the returned products.

title: Returns, Refunds and Quality Guarantee
text:
If you have not received your refund 10 business days after the confirmation e-mail, first check
with your bank, then contact customer service with your order number and return authorisation
number. Customer service can trace the refund and, if it was not issued, issue it the same day.
